tasks.title: Propose sealed statements for agroforestry land and light accounting
tasks.brief: Draft 2 statements, one module each in proposals/, exactly as specified in inputs/context/STATEMENT_PROPOSAL.md. Read README.md first: it says what this project does and does not claim. Check each 'check before proposing' note by hand before you write the Lean. Write the mathematics in Lean over Mathlib only, with every definition inside the statement's own namespace. Include the sanity checks listed there as checked examples, and describe the negative control in the rationale. The rationale file lists every hypothesis and says what the statement does not settle.

tasks.title: Prove that the land equivalent ratio is the least matching sole-crop area
tasks.brief: Prove the sealed statement P8.LandEquivalentRatio. The paper states the definition, the four parts and the proof, with the worked example LER = 5/4. Say what it settles (LER is exactly the least sole-crop land that matches the mixture, and a no-interaction mosaic has LER = 1) and what it does not (any yield, value, labour or risk; LER above 1 does not say the mixture is worth more). Credit Mead and Willey 1980.

tasks.title: Prove the two-layer light budget for trees above a crop
tasks.brief: Prove the sealed statement P8.LightBudget. The paper states the two-layer Beer-Lambert model, the budget identity, the shading factor and the effect of more tree leaf area, and gives the proof. Say plainly that real alley and row systems are not horizontally uniform, so this is a bound on an idealised stand, and that extinction coefficients and leaf areas are field inputs. Credit Monsi and Saeki 1953.
